newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ARGENTINE CHAMOT FACES TWO MONTH LAYOFF.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ARGENTINE CHAMOT FACES TWO MONTH LAYOFF.

text.p: Lazio's Argentine international defender Jose Antonio Chamot faces a two month layoff after tearing ligaments in his right elbow and dislocating his shoulder on Saturday.
Club doctor Claudio Bartolini told reporters that Chamot was injured after he fell in a tussle with Fiorentina midfielder Sandro Cois in the clubs' 0-0 serie A clash.
Bartolini said that Chamot would need to have his arm in plaster for at least 25 days. A further month would be needed for rehabilitation treatment.
